metadata.description: Retain every metadata field. Missing facts remain explicit unknown values; do not invent facts or repeat the same source limitation in each field.

CardOnlyCardDraft.title: CardOnlyCardDraft
CardOnlyCardDraft.description: One complete source card, without a mandatory research-question workflow.

candidate_ids.title: Candidate Ids
candidate_ids.description: Qualified source-backed candidate IDs. Entity/event/relation findings use objects of the same kind with overlapping evidence; an explicitly retained, evidenced alias may cover a relation_kind=alias source finding without a duplicate relation edge. Important fact findings may cite card_id/item_id, card_id/metadata/field, card_id/formation_date or card_id/event_date. An event finding still requires an event with unchanged modality. Missing important facts require status=missing, a precise reason and decision=pending.

CardOnlyMention.title: CardOnlyMention
CardOnlyMention.description: Policy-v6 source mentions; older entity enums retain their frozen meanings.

checked_search_receipt_ids.title: Checked Search Receipt Ids
checked_search_receipt_ids.description: Every server search receipt ID in candidate.required_checks

checked_mechanical_evidence_ids.title: Checked Mechanical Evidence Ids
checked_mechanical_evidence_ids.description: Every decoded mechanical evidence receipt ID in candidate.required_checks; semantic review remains separate

start.title: Start
start.description: Start in source-unit text, measured in Unicode code points.

end.title: End
end.description: Exclusive end in source-unit text, measured in Unicode code points.

date.description: Use an explicit unknown date when the source supplies none.

place.description: Explicit source place or unknown value='' with a note.

participant_roles.title: Participant Roles
participant_roles.description: One evidenced role per retained participant, or [] if none is identified.

candidate_ids.title: Candidate Ids
candidate_ids.description: Qualified card_id/object_id values only, from mentions/events/relations of the same kind as this independent finding, with overlapping evidence in its source article. Items, related entities of another kind and bare object IDs cannot establish coverage. If missing, use status=missing with a precise reason and decision=pending.

source_evidence_ids.title: Source Evidence Ids
source_evidence_ids.description: IDs in this output card.evidence citing this card's own primary source; not evidence IDs taken from a counterpart card.

target_evidence_ids.title: Target Evidence Ids
target_evidence_ids.description: IDs in this output card.evidence citing the exact frozen counterpart source. Copy the actual frozen-source span into this card under a new local evidence ID; counterpart-card evidence IDs belong to a separate namespace and cannot be reused as references.

EntityMention.title: EntityMention
EntityMention.description: A source mention, never a name-only identity merge across publications.

start.title: Start
start.description: Canonical chapter Markdown offset in Unicode codepoints.

end.title: End
end.description: Exclusive canonical chapter Markdown offset in Unicode codepoints.

value.title: Value
value.description: When certainty=unknown, use value=''. Do not put missing facts or uncertainty labels here.

certainty.title: Certainty
certainty.description: Unknown means no factual value is supplied. A broad but explicit source value may be stated; retain evidence and describe its precision in note.

note.title: Note
note.description: Explain missing facts, uncertainty, attribution and precision limits here; an unknown value remains empty.

SourceValue.title: SourceValue
SourceValue.description:
Source-backed fact: certainty=unknown requires an empty value; explain absent facts in note.

A vague but explicit source place is still stated, with its precision limits in note.

checked_search_receipt_ids.description: Every server search receipt ID in candidate.required_checks

checked_mechanical_evidence_ids.title: Checked Mechanical Evidence Ids
checked_mechanical_evidence_ids.description: Every decoded mechanical evidence receipt ID in candidate.required_checks; semantic review remains separate
